source: 6818824 plus irq-context (handler-entry CX/DX replayed as interrupt input in the step check)

levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Scenario checks run natively against references recorded once per DOS executable (build/reference/, portable/tests/acceptance/step_check.py, seconds per scenario). Native replays each DOS run's own per-site clock values and its chronological service order (clock reads, BIOS keyboard samples, queue-count samples, pumps, simulation boundaries); each recorded input is admitted at its recorded service position through the ordinary SDL adapter. The canonical lane (native vs canonical DOS) tests the port, the original lane tests the whole chain. Verdicts are game state per DoAntSim entry. The handler-entry CX/DX a keyboard IRQ copies into its event (on DOS the wrapper's DGROUP residue) is replayed from the tape as part of the interrupt.

scenarios.new-game-save (64 entries): equal in game state for all 64 entries in both lanes (native = original DOS, native = canonical DOS).
scenarios.quick-game (2000 entries): equal in game state for all 2000 entries in both lanes.
scenarios.long-run (3000 entries, unattended): equal in game state for all 3000 entries in both lanes, about 10 s per lane.
scenarios.original repeatability: original recorded twice: all 307 SaveRec records equal at every entry in all three scenarios; quick-game window_current_event differs from entry 1703 between repeats (observation setup differed; cause not isolated)

finish_line: Port verified faithful for normal play when every corpus scenario (new-game-save, quick-game, an unattended long run, load-from-save, experiment mode) is equal three ways in game state for its whole step count, frames and sound streams are compared at checkpoints, and the native check of all scenarios runs in under a minute as part of the port suites.
